label: General

criteria.label: Balance
criteria.look_for: controlled posture through the action, no falling away
criteria.drill: Slow repetitions, holding the finish for two seconds.

criteria.label: Extension through the action
criteria.look_for: the working arm extends through the action
criteria.drill: Shadow reps: freeze at full extension and check the arm line.

criteria.label: Base and knee bend
criteria.look_for: stable base with the knees loading and driving
criteria.drill: Load-and-drive repetitions with a deliberate knee bend.

camera_angles.label: Side view
camera_angles.description: Camera at 90 degrees to the action. Best for arm extension and lean.

camera_angles.label: Front view
camera_angles.description: Camera facing the athlete. Best for balance and knee alignment.

coaching_note: Describe the athletic action shown and judge technique conservatively.
